name: mobile-use (Minitap)
description: Agent that controls real Android and iOS apps from natural language and can return structured data scraped from them.
whatItDoes: Operates a phone to finish tasks inside apps and to pull information out of them in a requested output shape. It targets developers automating mobile workflows and data collection.
howItWorks: Several cooperating agents plan and execute UI actions against a connected device or emulator. A launcher script starts the stack in Docker, or the main module can be run directly with a goal and an optional description of the desired output.

requirements.name: LLM provider key
requirements.description: Key for a supported provider, set in the env file

run: bash ./mobile-use.sh "Open Gmail, find first 3 unread emails, and list their sender and subject line" --output-description "A JSON list of objects, each with 'sender' and 'subject' keys"
